name: Picture, AI galleries
description: Artwork from Civitai, Lexica or both. Filter by tags, creators or prompt terms, preview up to 20 matches, then rotate images that suit the cell orientation and resolution.

cell_options.name: pinned_image
cell_options.label: Pinned artwork
cell_options.help: Choose an artwork using Show chosen in Lineups, or leave blank for normal rotation. A pin still obeys the frame orientation, resolution and filters. Pinned renders do not advance rotation history.

cell_options.name: provider
cell_options.label: Gallery service
cell_options.help: Combine both galleries, or use either one. Each service keeps its own cache and retry limits; if one is unavailable, eligible artwork from the other remains available. Creator and engagement settings apply to Civitai only.

cell_options.name: lexica_query
cell_options.label: Lexica search
cell_options.help: Search description, up to 300 characters. Include and exclude terms below are then checked against each returned prompt. Only results explicitly marked safe and not a multi-image grid are used.

cell_options.name: positive_tags
cell_options.label: Include tags / prompt terms
cell_options.help: Comma- or newline-separated tag names or numeric IDs, up to 6. Starts with illustration or painting. Tags use OR by default. Creator picks take priority; these tags add secondary discoveries. A Civitai API key enables full name lookup. Without one, other names must occur in the sampled public feed. Blank tags and creators use the popular public feed. On Lexica, these are literal words or phrases required in the generation prompt, rather than image tags; Any / All matching applies. Leave blank to use all search results.

cell_options.name: users
cell_options.label: Creators
cell_options.help: Comma- or newline-separated Civitai usernames, up to 4. Prefer artwork from these creators even without an included tag; tags provide secondary discoveries. Excluded tags and minimum engagement still apply to every image. Leave blank to discover by tags.

cell_options.name: negative_tags
cell_options.label: Exclude tags / prompt terms
cell_options.help: Comma- or newline-separated tag names or numeric IDs, up to 50. Starts by excluding photographic styles. An image with any excluded tag is rejected, even if it also has an included tag. No API key is needed for tag-name exclusions. On Lexica, these exclude literal words or phrases in the generation prompt.

cell_options.name: orientation
cell_options.label: Orientation
cell_options.help: Auto follows this cell's width and height, including square cells. Landscape and portrait exclude square images. No fallback to the wrong orientation; choose Any to accept every shape.

cell_options.name: resolution
cell_options.label: Resolution
cell_options.help: Prefer native uses images that need no enlargement, falling back to smaller images only if none qualify. Native only shows no match instead. Based on the cell dimensions and Fit or Fill scale; enlargement uses ordinary browser resizing.

cell_options.name: scale
cell_options.label: Scale
cell_options.help: Fill is the default: edge-to-edge artwork, cropping the edges as needed. Fit preserves the whole image with letterboxing. Neither stretches the image's proportions.

cell_options.name: refresh_hours
cell_options.label: Collection refresh (hours)
cell_options.help: How often to fetch a new candidate pool. Tesserae must render the widget to fetch updates.

cell_options.name: rotation_minutes
cell_options.label: Image rotation (minutes)
cell_options.help: A stable image per placement and time interval, advancing through the pool without repeats. Changes appear on the next Tesserae render; this does not schedule device refreshes.

cell_options.name: repeat_days
cell_options.label: Avoid repeats (days)
cell_options.help: Prefer artwork not selected for this placement within this window (7 days by default). Use a whole number; 0 disables the lookback. History survives collection refreshes. If every eligible image is recent, reuse the oldest pick. Previews do not advance history.

cell_options.name: sort
cell_options.label: Prioritize
cell_options.help: How Civitai ranks candidate artwork within the source time period (Month by default). Rotation cycles through the cached matches. Each priority has its own shared cache.

cell_options.name: min_reactions
cell_options.label: Minimum reactions
cell_options.help: Minimum combined likes, hearts, laughs and cries reported by Civitai. Use a whole number; 0 disables this filter. Missing counts cannot satisfy a positive minimum. Filters the cached collection without extra API requests.

cell_options.name: min_comments
cell_options.label: Minimum comments
cell_options.help: Minimum comment count reported by Civitai. Use a whole number; 0 disables this filter. Missing counts cannot satisfy a positive minimum. Counts update with the daily collection refresh.

cell_options.name: show_credit
cell_options.label: Show creator credit
cell_options.help: A quiet service and creator credit at the bottom of the image, linked to the original artwork in the editor.

settings.name: api_key
settings.label: Civitai API key
settings.help: Optional. Enables full image tag-name lookup. Create a free personal API key at https://civitai.com/user/account. The public image feed and creator filters work without a key.

fields.name: images
fields.label: Filtered image pool (service, ID, URL, dimensions, creator, link, tags or prompt, and engagement counts when available)

fields.name: selected_id
fields.label: Selected image for this rotation interval
